the 100-day promise

planned — not live during the pilot. nobody pays during the pilot, so there's nothing to refund yet. here's how it will work once plus and the table launch.

if you're on plus or the table, walk a hundred days on your path. if at the end of them you feel nothing — not calmer, not more grounded, not more yourself — we refund the whole year. no form. no call. no "tell us why." one tap in settings.

the fine print, in plain words

a hundred days means a hundred days on the path, not a hundred calendar days — days are earned, so missing some doesn't count against you; grace is free. the promise covers the plus year or the table year and it's once per person, because that's fair. the house is free anyway, so there's nothing to refund there.

why a hundred

nobody's changed by a lesson. everybody's changed by a hundred of them. that's long enough for the practice to become part of you — and if you show up and it doesn't, that's on us.

start now. it's free.
